buttons: LP1=Left Punch=Tekken 1, RP2=Right Punch=Tekken 2, LK3=Left Kick=Tekken 3, RK4=Right Kick=Tekken 4
frame_data_note: The TTT2 Jun movelist page documents input, damage, and hit level/range. It does NOT document startup frames. Every entry below therefore has timing_status NEEDS-SPEC. Do NOT wire frame data from this file. Pose/choreography notes are MADE interpretations of the documented name, limb, and hit level — they are not decoded motion.

moves.made_pose: First hit: left-hand jab (LP1) at head height. Second hit: left-hand strike dropping to mid height. Two distinct left-arm extensions, not one punch held.
moves.name: Whiplash (TTT2 Jun)
moves.timing_status: NEEDS-SPEC — startup, active, recovery undocumented on the TTT2 movelist page.

moves.made_pose: Left jab at head height (LP1), followed by a right-hand uppercut-style rising strike at head height (RP2).
moves.name: Jab Uppercut (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: Left jab (LP1), right uppercut (RP2), then a spinning right-kick finish at mid height (RK4) — the spin is in the move name and is part of the spec.
moves.name: Jab Uppercut Spin Kick (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: Left jab at head height (LP1), followed by a left low kick (LK3).
moves.name: Jab Low Kick (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: Simultaneous double-palm thrust at mid height, both arms (LP1+RP2 input). Distinct from Kaimon: this is the neutral Jun strike, not the GEN wall-splat.
moves.name: Shunkei (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: Forward-stepping right-hand mid strike (RP2), advancing toward the opponent. The forward step is in the input (f+).
moves.name: Demon Slayer (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: Forward left mid kick (LK3) with a forward step (f+ input).
moves.name: Kanbashira (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: Forward right high kick (RK4) with a forward step (f+ input).
moves.name: Getsukankyaku (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: Crouching-forward left mid kick (LK3) from the d/f input.
moves.name: Minazuki (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: Back-step left mid wheel kick (LK3) — a turning/rotating kick, as the name states, from the b+ input.
moves.name: Dragon Wheel Kick (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: Low-to-high double lift: first a low kick, then a rising high kick, both legs (LK3+RK4 input). The low-then-high order is documented by the hit levels.
moves.name: Double Lift Kicks (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: Back-input stance (GEN): both hands (LP1+RP2) raised into a stance hold, weight back. This is the Jun stance that Megami's Threshold Keeper / Kaimon build on. Hold-loop detail is NEEDS-SPEC (see README).
moves.name: Genjitsu (TTT2 Jun stance)

moves.made_pose: From GEN stance, a low left-hand strike (LP1).
moves.name: Rurikoukai — During Genjitsu (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: From GEN stance, a mid right-hand strike (RP2).
moves.name: Tachiaoi — During Genjitsu (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: From GEN stance, a mid left kick (LK3).
moves.name: Getsuun — During Genjitsu (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: From GEN stance, a high right kick (RK4) — the heaviest GEN follow-up by documented damage (28).
moves.name: Nichiun — During Genjitsu (TTT2 Jun)

moves.made_pose: Forward double-hand high strike (LP1+RP2) that also opens the Izumo stance state in TTT2. Izumo follow-ups are documented on the TTT2 page but are NOT spec'd in this batch — they are out of scope here and fall to the TTT2 extraction (or a follow-up MADE batch). Do not treat this entry as the full Izumo set.
moves.name: Izumo (TTT2 Jun — entry strike only)
moves.scope_note: Izumo follow-ups (Izumo LP1 / RP2 / LK3 / RK4 / LP1+RP2 / LK3+RK4 lines and Tsukuyomi throw) are NOT in this batch.
